stops.note: Leave 07:00, about 80 minutes before sunrise. A rental car with an environmental label is not affected by Madrid's low-emission rules.
Walled medieval town: in through the Puerta Baja, up to the Basílica de Santa María and along the walls for the view. About 2 hours with a coffee.
Av. de Don Juan Tenorio s/n, the retail area on the north-east edge of town, just off the A-2. The old town and the university are 3 km away.
Back at the airport before sunset (about 17:50). Refuel before returning the rental car.
Leave 08:00, just before sunrise. The route stays outside Málaga's low-emission zone.
Seafront promenade at sunrise, and Sohail Castle above the river mouth: at this hour see it from outside.
Dolmens of Menga and Viera (UNESCO): Sundays 09:00–15:00, free for EU citizens, free car park at the entrance.
Lunch, then the Mezquita-Catedral (Sunday visits 15:00–18:00) and the Roman bridge at dusk. Park at Paseo de la Victoria, at the edge of the old town.
Last hour on the A-45 / A-7 motorway after dark. Refuel before returning the rental car.
Leave 11:30. If the car isn't Madrid-registered, start outside the city limits.
Gothic cathedral right off the A-1. About 1.5h.
Arrive about 18:15, the last 40 minutes after dark on the motorway. Floodlit Guggenheim from outside (last entry 18:30), then pintxos in the Casco Viejo by metro.
Fishing port on the cliffside N-634 between Zumaia and Zarautz.
La Concha bay and a pintxos lunch. Park outside the ZBE.
Sunset over the Rocher de la Vierge, around 17:20.
A balcony view of the whole Pyrenean chain. About 1h.
Walk up to the floodlit Cité after dark.
Roman aqueduct, 30 minutes off the A9.

Triangular piazza, lit up for Christmas.
